info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Risk Model Submission API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of operational risk models to the banking system, enhancing risk management strategies. Consumers of this API typically include risk analysts and financial institutions seeking to integrate new models into their operational risk frameworks. The functionality includes validating, uploading, and categorizing models to improve decision-making processes related to financial risk. This ensures that businesses maintain compliance and optimize their risk assessments effectively.

post.summary: Create a new operational risk model.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational risk model by submitting the necessary details in the request body. Ensure all required fields are completed to successfully create the model.
